description.message: See the real domain of any site and check suspicious links before you fall for them.

verdictOk.message: No obvious warning signs in this address. Still, never enter passwords or codes from a link you were sent.

verdictRisk.message: Careful: this address has signs used in scams.

notWeb.message: Open a web page to check its address.

flagHttp.message: No https: the connection isn't encrypted. Don't type your data here.

flagIp.message: It's an IP address instead of a domain name.

flagAt.message: It contains “@”: everything before it is ignored, the real site is what comes after.

flagPunycode.message: Letters from another alphabet (“xn--”) that imitate a real name.

flagTld.message: Cheap ending widely used in scams (.top, .xyz, .click…).

flagBrandSub.message: A well-known brand appears before someone else's domain.

flagLookalike.message: The domain imitates a brand with numbers or hyphens.

privacy.message: The check happens in your browser. We don't see your browsing.

menuLink.message: Is it a scam? Check this link
